description: This Java source file defines the 'EntityDataAssert' class, which provides utility methods for loading, verifying, and asserting seed data of entities from XML resources or value lists within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for checking entity records against expected data, primarily for testing or data validation purposes.

classes.name: EntityDataAssert
classes.description: A utility class for loading, validating, and asserting seed entity data within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: assertData
methods.description: Loads XML data from a provided URL and checks each record against the database, returning the number of rows processed.

methods.name: checkValueList
methods.description: Checks a list of GenericValue objects against the database, accumulating error messages.

methods.name: checkSingleValue
methods.description: Checks a single GenericValue record against the corresponding database record, comparing non-PK fields and recording discrepancies.
